subject: general
question: What is the minimum age requirement (prescribed by the Constitution) for being a member of a Panchayat?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 21 years.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The minimum age necessary for being a member of a panchayat is **21 years. **
 
• Panchayat is the **local government body in India.**
 
• The **73rd Amendment** attached **Part IX** in the constitution of India and was named** “The Panchayats”.**
 
• The panchayat leader is known as **Sarpanch in Hindi**, and each of the five members is a **Gram Panchayat Sadasya or Panch.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **​Panchayati Raj** is a structure of government at the village level where each village is** in charge for its own activities.**
 
• The **Amendment Act of 1992 **holds provision for passing the powers and control to the **panchayat for the preparation of plans for economic development and social justice.**
 
• The** Village Panchayat, Block Panchayat and District Panchayat** are the 3 areas of Panchayat Raj system in India.** **
